d: Long, flowing pastel pink hair with straight bangs and two long, thin braids falling over the shoulders. Wide, sparkling light pink eyes with a youthful, innocent expression on a face of an adolescent with a slender, petite build. A white and gold ornate clerical outfit featuring a high-collared dress with dark grey ribbons, a matching white mitre-style hat with a blue gem, and white boots with gold accents. A golden scepter held in one hand and a translucent dark energy orb swirling around the other.
